newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nisshin Steel to replace galvanising line.
newsitem.headline: Nisshin Steel to replace galvanising line.

text.p: Nisshin Steel said on Friday it will spend 20 billion yen to build a new continuous galvanising line at its Toyo works in Ehime Prefecture to replace a 32-year-old line to be scrapped at its Ichikawa works in Chiba Prefecture.
Construction of the new facility will begin in January 1998 and is scheduled for completion in late 1999, the company said.

A Nisshin spokesman said that, while production capacity at the new facility will be 40,000 tonnes per month of zinc and zinc-aluminium coated steel sheet, it will initially produce only 30,000 tonnes per month, in line with current output at the Ichikawa works.
The company said the new line will boost quality and lower production costs, although it did not disclose any estimates for expected cost savings.
